The one-key first-message Auth statement (Lemma 1, second conjunct)

Trusted: the statement. Every definition in this file is part of SignalPqxdh.Security.PqxdhAuth1KeySecureδ, the second conjunct of PqxdhSecureδ in Lemma 1 (SignalPqxdh.Security.PqxdhCorrectAndSecureδ, Security/HeadlineDelta.lean). Read it alongside the game in Security/Auth/Game.lean, the shared ReductionDsl tables and budgets in Security/Headline.lean and CostedBudgets.lean, and KemCorrect.lean. See Computational/docs/TRUSTED_BASE.md.

This file extends the 11-tag handshake primitive interface with the 8 first-message ratcheting and AEAD operations (AuthPTag), defines the ReductionDsl challenger interfaces and authSpec S game codec over pqAtomicSig, and states that a costed seven-reduction family (sig, shcr, gdh, ck, mk, cpa, int) bounds Auth1KeyAdvantage by pqxdhAuthAdvantageBoundδ under both the uniform (stepCostBudget) and online/random-oracle split (stepCostBudgetSplit) step-cost budgets.

def pqxdhAuthAdvantageBoundδL310–316 ↗#

Advantage bound for Auth under a δ-correct KEM: pqxdhAuthBound plus a single kemDecapsFailureTerm S δ across all KEM decapsulations in the game.

noncomputable def pqxdhAuthAdvantageBoundδ (S : Setup) (q_roRoot : ℕ) (δ : ℝ≥0∞) (epsSig epsKemShCr epsGapDh epsPrfCk epsPrfMsgKeys epsAeadCpa epsPrfHmac : ℝ≥0∞) : ℝ≥0∞ := pqxdhAuthBound S q_roRoot epsSig epsKemShCr epsGapDh epsPrfCk epsPrfMsgKeys epsAeadCpa epsPrfHmac + kemDecapsFailureTerm S δ

def authGdhQueryBudgetL338–349 ↗#

Semantic DDH-query budget for the sig and gdh reductions in Auth: bilinear random-oracle-by-session consistency checks ((4 · M_ro + M_root) · M_sess) plus distinct session-pair checks (3 · M_sess · (M_sess - 1)), capped at 5 · q_total², together with q_total + N_dh + N_sess_tot final-extraction queries. Because only online queries create sessions, M_sess is clamped at min (min b.q_on b.q_total) S.N_sess_tot.

def authGdhQueryBudget (S : Setup) (b : QueryBudget) : Nat := let M_ro := min b.q_ro b.q_total let M_root := min b.q_roRoot b.q_total let M_sess := min (min b.q_on b.q_total) S.N_sess_tot min (5 * b.q_total ^ 2) ((4 * M_ro + M_root) * M_sess + 3 * M_sess * (M_sess - 1)) + b.q_total + S.N_dh + S.N_sess_tot

def Auth1KeyCostedReductionFamily.evalL386–430 ↗#

Evaluates an Auth1KeyCostedReductionFamily S into a semantic Auth1KeyReductionFamily S with fuel b.q_total, default output false, signing budget 2 * min S.N_spk_tot S.N_recv, DDH budget authGdhQueryBudget S b, and PRF budgets 1 (ck) and S.N_recv_tot + 1 (mk, int).

def Auth1KeyCostedReductionFamily.eval {S : Setup} (R : Auth1KeyCostedReductionFamily S) : Auth1KeyReductionFamily S where sig b A := { run := fun pk => (R.sig b).eval (fun _ => A.1.run) pk q_sig := 2 * min S.N_spk_tot S.N_recv q_ddh := authGdhQueryBudget S b q_prim := gdhPrimQueryBudget S b } shcr b A := { State := Mid (authSpec S) Bool (R.shcr b).π.denote (R.shcr b).σ.denote (PB 1568).denote choosePk := fun pk sk => (R.shcr b).eval1 (fun _ => A.1.run) (pk, sk) b.q_total false findCollision := fun st ss ct => (R.shcr b).eval2 st (ss, ct) b.q_total false q_prim := primQueryBudget S b } gdh b A := { run := fun U V => (R.gdh b).eval (fun _ => A.1.run) (U, V) q_ddh := authGdhQueryBudget S b q_sig := 2 * min S.N_spk_tot S.N_recv q_prim := gdhPrimQueryBudget S b } ck b A := { dist := fun mkSeedChal ck1_1Chal => (R.ck b).eval (fun _ => A.1.run) (mkSeedChal, ck1_1Chal) q_prf := 1 q_prim := primQueryBudget S b } mk b A := { run := (R.mk b).eval (fun _ => A.1.run) () q_prf := S.N_recv_tot + 1 q_prim := primQueryBudget S b } cpa b A := { State := Mid (authSpec S) Bool (R.cpa b).π.denote (R.cpa b).σ.denote (Ty.prod (PB 158) (Ty.prod (PB 32) (PB 32))).denote choose := do let r ← (R.cpa b).eval1 (fun _ => A.1.run) () b.q_total false pure (r.1.1, r.1.2.1, r.1.2.2, r.2) dist := fun st c? => (R.cpa b).eval2 st c? b.q_total false q_prim := primQueryBudget S b } int b A := { run := (R.int b).eval (fun _ => A.1.run) () q_prf := S.N_recv_tot + 1 q_prim := primQueryBudget S b }

def authQueryKindL432–437 ↗#

Classifies AuthQuery into online queries (0, matching isAuthOnlineQuery) and offline random-oracle queries .roQuery and .roRootQuery (1) for per-kind step-cost accounting.

def authQueryKind {S : Setup} : AuthQuery S → Fin 2 | .roQuery _ => 1 | .roRootQuery _ _ => 1 | _ => 0

def authKindCountsL439–443 ↗#

Per-kind query caps for a b-bounded AuthAdversary: min b.q_on b.q_total online queries (0) and min (b.q_ro + b.q_roRoot) b.q_total random-oracle queries (1).

def authKindCounts (b : QueryBudget) : Fin 2 → ℕ | 0 => min b.q_on b.q_total | 1 => min (b.q_ro + b.q_roRoot) b.q_total

structure Auth1KeyReductionQueryBoundsL522–531 ↗#

Semantic query-budget compliance for an Auth1KeyReductionFamily S: every component reduction adversary satisfies its .Bounded predicate for all b and A.

structure Auth1KeyReductionQueryBounds (S : Setup) (R : Auth1KeyReductionFamily S) : Prop where sig_bounded : ∀ b A, (R.sig b A).Bounded shcr_bounded : ∀ b A, (R.shcr b A).Bounded gdh_bounded : ∀ b A, (R.gdh b A).Bounded ck_bounded : ∀ b A, (R.ck b A).Bounded mk_bounded : ∀ b A, (R.mk b A).Bounded cpa_bounded : ∀ b A, (R.cpa b A).Bounded int_bounded : ∀ b A, (R.int b A).Bounded

def PqxdhAuth1KeyReductionBoundδL535–550 ↗#

Advantage-reduction bound for R : Auth1KeyReductionFamily S: for every δ-correct well-formed primitive suite P and b-bounded adversary A, Auth1KeyAdvantage S P A.1 is bounded by pqxdhAuthAdvantageBoundδ evaluated at the seven component advantages of R.

def PqxdhAuth1KeyReductionBoundδ (S : Setup) (R : Auth1KeyReductionFamily S) : Prop := ∀ (P : Primitives), CryptoWellFormedPrimitivesδ P → ∀ (δ : ℝ≥0∞), KemDeltaCorrect P δ → ∀ (b : QueryBudget) (A : BoundedAdv (AuthAdversary S) b), Auth1KeyAdvantage S P A.1 ≤ pqxdhAuthAdvantageBoundδ S b.q_roRoot δ (GapSigEufCma P P.isValidDhTriple (R.sig b A)) (KemShCr P (R.shcr b A)) (GapDhWithSign P P.isValidDhTriple P.pow8 (R.gdh b A)) (PrfChainKey P (R.ck b A)) (PrfMsgKeys P (R.mk b A)) (AeadIndCpa P (R.cpa b A)) (PrfHmac P (R.int b A))

def PqxdhAuth1KeySecureδL552–562 ↗#

One-key first-message authentication and privacy at setup S under a δ-correct KEM: there exists a costed reduction family R : Auth1KeyCostedReductionFamily S that satisfies syntactic resource bounds, semantic query bounds, and PqxdhAuth1KeyReductionBoundδ S R.eval.

def PqxdhAuth1KeySecureδ (S : Setup) : Prop := ∃ R : Auth1KeyCostedReductionFamily S, Auth1KeyCostedReductionBounds S R ∧ Auth1KeyReductionQueryBounds S R.eval ∧ PqxdhAuth1KeyReductionBoundδ S R.eval
end SignalPqxdh.Security
